available_resources: An existing HTML scratch file and its preview

output.title: Make one button
output.description: One small element is enough for this step.
steps: In your existing scratch HTML file, type: <button>Hello</button>.
Open its preview once and look at the button.
Change Hello to your name, preview it again, then stop.
output.reflection: What changed when you edited the text?

output.title: Recall one CSS property
output.description: Try one small recall check without opening your notes.
steps: Without looking it up, name the CSS property that sets an element's background color.
Type your best answer, even if you are unsure.
Reveal the check after your attempt; compare it, then stop.
output.reflection: What might help you recognize this property next time?

output.title: Connect two cell structures
output.description: A single connection can make a larger idea clearer.
steps: Use these facts: the nucleus holds genetic instructions; ribosomes build proteins using those instructions.
Write: nucleus → ribosome, and label the arrow with the relationship in your own words.
Read your connection once and check that both structures have different roles. Stop there.
output.reflection: Which role would you like to revisit?

output.title: Explain a steady beat
output.description: Start with a rhythm you already recognize.
steps: Tap a slow, steady beat on your leg four times.
Explain in one sentence how that repeating beat could help two musicians start together.
Say your sentence once, then stop tapping.
output.reflection: What familiar activity also uses a shared rhythm?
